# neo_faker v0.14.0 - Table of Contents

Fake data generator for Elixir tests and development environments.

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [Getting Started](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/getting-started.md)
- [Supported Locales](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/locales.md)
- [Cheat Sheet](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/cheat.md)

## Modules

- Random Generators
  - [NeoFaker](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/NeoFaker.md): NeoFaker is a package for generating fake data in Elixir.
  - [NeoFaker.Address](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/NeoFaker.Address.md): Functions for generating random address data.
  - [NeoFaker.App](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/NeoFaker.App.md): Functions for generating app metadata.
  - [NeoFaker.Blood](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/NeoFaker.Blood.md): Functions for generating blood types.
  - [NeoFaker.Boolean](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/NeoFaker.Boolean.md): Functions for generating random boolean values.
  - [NeoFaker.Color](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/NeoFaker.Color.md): Functions for generating random colors.
  - [NeoFaker.Crypto](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/NeoFaker.Crypto.md): Functions for generating cryptographic hashes and tokens.
  - [NeoFaker.Date](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/NeoFaker.Date.md): Functions for generating random dates.
  - [NeoFaker.Gravatar](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/NeoFaker.Gravatar.md): Functions for generating random Gravatar URLs.
  - [NeoFaker.HTTP](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/NeoFaker.HTTP.md): Functions for generating HTTP-related data.
  - [NeoFaker.Internet](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/NeoFaker.Internet.md): Functions for generating internet-related data.
  - [NeoFaker.Lorem](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/NeoFaker.Lorem.md): Functions for generating Lorem Ipsum text.
  - [NeoFaker.Number](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/NeoFaker.Number.md): Functions for generating random numbers.
  - [NeoFaker.Person](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/NeoFaker.Person.md): Functions for generating person-related information.
  - [NeoFaker.Text](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/NeoFaker.Text.md): Functions for generating random text.
  - [NeoFaker.Time](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/NeoFaker.Time.md): Functions for generating random times.

- Locale Random Generators
  - [NeoFaker.EnUs.Person](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/NeoFaker.EnUs.Person.md): Functions for generating person-related information specific to the United States.
  - [NeoFaker.IdId.Person](https://neo-faker.hexdocs.pm/NeoFaker.IdId.Person.md): Functions for generating person-related information specific to Indonesia.
